key_gap: vs baseline: gap closed 0.5 → 0.1 (human 5.0 / v6-AI 4.9; J1 contested, verdict roughly equal/complementary). The non-routed v5 AI matched every number but reached its two best insights — the WIP-buffer signature as the empirical constraint locator and the constraint-movement step — via the verify machinery rather than the initial frame, and paid full option enumeration. The routed run made all three first-class m014 contract outputs (binding-constraint via min-math + WIP signature; exploit-before-elevate; smallest-change-to-lift with min-element pre-filter; constraint-moves monitoring with the post-A S2/S3 tie and next-lift rule), plus tempo mode priced the 12-week deadline and the m003 gate enumerated six ranked failure categories; residual gap is efficiency only — the human's single find→exploit→subordinate→elevate→repeat loop still outruns two passes plus gates.
learning_signal: On estimate/guarantee + deadline signatures with a serial-capacity chain, the m014 completion contract (min-math + WIP-signature first, exploit starvation free before any spend, smallest-change-to-lift pre-filter 'an option not touching the current min cannot change throughput', constraint-moves monitoring after every lift) converts the human's winning structure into frame-level moves and eliminates the v5 AI's redundant enumeration; pairing it with m031's falsifier + decisive-experiment (2-week post-lift measurement) and the m003 gate (ranked failure categories incl. deadline slip and the post-lift tie) covers everything the human implies in one line each.
suggested_improvement: Retain the m014+m031 dual-route with m003 gate and tempo mode on this signature; add a single-pass micro-route for fully-specified serial-capacity chains when m014 is top-1 by a wide margin (the dual-route's only remaining cost is efficiency 4.5 vs human 5 — a solo contract pass plus P8 fast path closes it); keep the next-lift rule ('demand > 100/hr ⇒ lift S2 and S3 together') as a standing packet line.

key_gap: vs baseline: held the win (human 2.5 / v6-AI 5.0). The pure-style human baseline failed both registered failure modes of the module: it presupposed the org-chart serial flow as fixed structure (dismissing the idle 250/day engine as a 'side channel') and treated the constraint as static over the investment horizon (hiring 5 adjudicators that land after the mix shift dissolves the constraint, month-6 high-touch ≈ 353 < 400 — $1.2M/yr for zero throughput gain). The routed run (m018 steelman + m019 red team, m044 synthesis, m003 gate) formalized the structure-first check the non-routed v5 AI reached ad hoc, and added two moves the v5 AI only partially owned: pricing the strongest version of the hire plan before rejecting it, and the ownership vacuum as the real organizational constraint (unconsulted stakeholder, m019 contract).
learning_signal: On decide/diagnose + guarantee signatures with an apparent capacity constraint, structure verification precedes constraint identification: enumerate ALL processing resources including idle and parallel ones regardless of the org chart, compute the flow under the current routing policy AND the best policy alternative, and stress the constraint at the investment's completion horizon — demand and mix can move it, and in this case dissolved it; when a policy change alone brings every resource below 100% utilization the system is demand-constrained and capacity spend is gated behind a quantified trigger (here: high-touch > 400/day, share > ~85%); interested-party provenance (who benefits from the diagnosis) and resource-ownership status are first-class inputs.
suggested_improvement: Retain the m018+m019+m044 dual-route with m003 gate on this signature (router already holds the serial-bottleneck framing out of top-3 — the NEG lesson is installed); promote the policy-artifact check to the m014 module's own completion contract ('before identifying any constraint: enumerate idle/parallel resources, test the routing-policy counterfactual, stress at the completion horizon') so the module is safe even when it IS routed; keep the 5-day verification + 25% sample fallback as the standing cheap-experiment pattern on policy-change fixes.
